title: Hypothetical retry attempt ceilings
method: Synthetic upper bounds: 100 originals + 2 × 100 retries = 300; or 100 originals + 1 × 20 eligible retries = 120. Counts do not establish recovery success or a universally correct policy.
alt: Hypothetical retry attempt ceilings. Two retries for all 100: 300 attempts; One retry for eligible 20: 120 attempts. Illustrative inputs.
